scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fabianmarcus/local-firebase-share && npm run build --workspace @fabianmarcus/react-local-firebase-share
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc --project tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint packages tests scripts *.ts *.mjs && prettier --check package.json packages tests scripts *.json *.ts *.mjs README.md LICENSE plans/*.md
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json packages tests scripts *.json *.ts *.mjs README.md LICENSE plans/*.md
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
